State which results are unconditional, which are conditional on v5/v9 or on the reciprocal INPUT subclass, and every missing proof as NOT_RECONSTRUCTED. No universal SPR7, tuple, negative box or emptiness claim beyond the proved region. Owner FOUR exactness majors, execution-scope erratum and parent finding v18 (erratum v4 symbolic-only breach) remain permanent.
